description: Tied duration is the total time an interaction process remains actively receiving responses from the group, computed from the temporal network by aggregating active intervals from first to last uptake, after trimming idle periods.
title: Tied-duration analysis of uptake and relevance in collaborative discourse

description: The article proposes an extension of the Gaussian hidden Markov model that \"incorporates parameters representing temporal change in a subtask appearance distribution for each learner,\" so that writing-process sequence patterns can be estimated from keystroke log data.
title: Time- and learner-dependent Gaussian hidden Markov model for writing-process sequence analysis

title: Time-course and mixed-effects analysis of educational eye-tracking data

description: The article recommends that researchers \"should avoid discarding trials whenever possible\", because removing early trials as practice replaces one stationarity assumption with another unprincipled one and, as the results show, is \"actually discarding signal, not noise\".
title: Time-sensitive trajectory modeling of practice effects
